description: Analytical data warehouse with full T-SQL support. Optimized for large-scale queries and reporting. Supports cross-database queries with lakehouses in the same workspace. Connect via TDS (SQL Server protocol) from any SQL client.

definition_parts.description: Single DACPAC binary encoded as InlineBase64. The documented upload name is sqldw.dacpac; live exports can use the warehouse display name.
Root SQL project plus separately encoded SQL source parts. The documented upload name is sqldw.sqlproj; live exports can use the warehouse display name.
Optional item metadata; update-definition applies it only with --update-metadata.

flags.--definition-file: Single DACPAC or SQL project definition file
flags.--definition-dir: Directory containing SQL project definition parts
flags.--definition-format: dacpac or sqlproj; omission uses sqlproj

notes: A public definition is optional on creation and mutually exclusive with --collation (creationPayload)
get-definition and update-definition support dacpac and sqlproj; omission defaults to sqlproj
Every definition part requires path, payload, and payloadType
Sensitivity labels are not included in or changed by public definitions
Query via TDS: connection string is <id>.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com
Supports three-part naming for cross-database queries within same workspace
SQL input accepts inline --sql, @file path, or stdin piping
connection-string command resolves the endpoint automatically
